verdict.rationale: Otter's enterprise docs say it can 'instantly auto-generate follow-up emails and next steps for client calls' (otter-docs-41), and its AI Chat helps create follow-ups from meeting content (otter-docs-1). This covers the core of the story: a drafted follow-up email built from the meeting. Missing for 10: any documented review-and-send flow (one-click send or an email-client handoff), detail on how drafts are edited or customized, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the drafts are usable.
